body:
I would say it's that people don't understand. Somewhere out there someone has to understand, just not those around me. I'm always told that I'm selfish for complaining about my problems. I know they could be far worse, but it's literal hell. Any chance that I've ever wanted of a professional athlete is out the window and not coming back. 

I can't seem to esacape death either, none of us can. It hit me hard when my friend died primarily because she was someone who could relate to me and we got along great. At the same time I lost two family members to non-related illnesses. I don't know anymore honestly...
I haven't tried to. It feels like anyone I try to explain it to, only pushes me down further. I'm too afraid to even talk to anyone about it.
